svg.title: マデイラ諸島の旅の地図
svg.desc: マデイラ島、ポルト・サント島、デザルタス諸島の実際の海岸線と8景の位置。セルヴァージェンシュ諸島は実海岸線を別枠で表示。
svg.metadata: Madeira, Porto Santo, Desertas shorelines from official DGT CAOP-derived MadeiraIlhas.geojson, nmota/caop_GeoJSON Git blob dee5716205349ac397ecebd0a7cf03446f559009 (CC BY 4.0); simplified WGS84, with topology repair for a coincident line segment. Selvagens real coastlines from the same CAOP source, fitted to a separate WGS84 inset (-16.10 to -15.80 W, 30.00 to 30.19 N); no invented coastlines. All coastlines are projected and colored adaptations. 2026-11-08.
